title: CoSMP
description: Welcome to CoSMP, a Cobblemon-powered survival experience where trainers and adventurers come together in a world full of exploration, competition, and discovery.
body:
Welcome to CoSMP, a Cobblemon-powered survival experience where trainers and adventurers come together in a world full of exploration, competition, and discovery.

Catch and train Pokémon, build your dream base, explore vast landscapes, and challenge other trainers as you forge your own story. Whether you seek peaceful adventures or intense battles, CoSMP offers a place for every kind of trainer.

Features
⚡ Hundreds of Pokémon to catch and train
🏠 Player-driven survival and base building
🌍 Expansive world to explore
🏆 Gym battles, tournaments, and events
🤝 Friendly multiplayer community
🔥 Constant progression and new adventures

Your journey starts here. Build, battle, explore, and become a legend in CoSMP. ✨

"Every great trainer has a beginning. What will yours be?" ⚡
